items.quote: we should be opening around 15% of our store base as the number that we want to increase annually.
items.statement: Store additions of around 15% of the store base each year (internal benchmark)
items.speaker: Anshul Asawa

items.quote: 15% kind of a gross margin and let's say around a 5% kind of a net margin should be the North Star for this business even in the future.
items.statement: Gross margin around 15% and net margin around 5% as long-term north star
items.speaker: Anshul Asawa

items.quote: we might go to an INR2,000 crores borrowing by the end of the year
items.statement: Possible INR2,000 crore borrowing by end of FY27 to fund capex
items.speaker: Niladri Deb

tone.label: cautious
